name: agent-undo
description: Time machine for AI coding agents: instant copy-on-write snapshots of the whole project (untracked files, node_modules) and safe, undoable rollback.

interface.shortDescription: Snapshot before danger, rewind when it breaks
interface.longDescription: Copy-on-write snapshots of the whole project, including untracked files and node_modules, taken automatically before risky shell commands. Diff and roll back everything or only the broken paths; every revert is itself undoable.
defaultPrompt: Take a checkpoint before this refactor.
What changed since the last snapshot?
Roll back only the files that broke the build.
